fields.title: 📖 Muḥākamah: Nothing is placed before Allah and His Messenger ﷺ
fields.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Kathīr** said:

> ***“Ibn Kathīr explained that the believers should not place anything before Allah and His Messenger ﷺ — neither a statement nor a deed.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever honors the Ḥukm of Allah places no opinion, no law, and no human being before Allah and His Messenger ﷺ.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn Kathīr, Tafsīr al-Qurʾān al-ʿAẓīm, Tafsīr zu Sūrah al-Ḥujurāt 49:1.
